name: vigipy Studio - Medical Device, Drug & Treatment-Outcome Signal Detection
description: High-performance surveillance platform powered by vigipy 3.4 for medical devices (MAUDE), pharmaceuticals (FAERS), and clinical interventions. Disproportionality analysis (PRR, ROR, RFET, BCPNN, GPS, LASSO, SCORE-DA, SCORE-DDI), consensus triangulation, and longitudinal modeling.
